topic: remove a scratch from patent leather shoes
core_question: How do I get rid of a scratch on patent leather shoes?
answer_summary: Dab a small amount of petroleum jelly onto the scratch and rub it in with a soft cloth in circular motions until the scratch is less visible, then buff off the excess.
